_about: the C library calls behind bits.json, as the C library of the machine that made it answers them: pow (every power), atan2, cos and sin, each [function, argument bits, result bits], pow as (x, y) and atan2 as (y, x); every case lists the entries it uses; pinned holds the two colors whose way back from OKLCH a unit test pins (lch in, rgb out). A power of 0 or 1, a power to the 0 and an atan2 of a zero y are exact on every C library and are not listed
